'''''Verbascum capitis-viridis''''' is a species of flowers that belongs to the family [[Scrophulariaceae]]. The species is endemic to [[Cape Verde]].<ref name="iucn status 12 November 2021" /> The species was first named ''Celsia insularis'' by [[Svante Samuel Murbeck|Murbeck]], but [[Arthur Huber-Morath]] placed it in the Verbascum species in 1973.<ref name=lobin>{{cite journal|title= The Genus Verbascum (Scrophulariaceae) on the Cape Verde Islands, W Africa|author1=W. Lobin|author2=S. Porembski|journal=[[Willdenowia (journal)|Willdenowia]]|volume=24|issue=1/2 |year=1994|pages=65–81|jstor = 3996680}}</ref> Its local name is ''sabão de feticeira''.<ref>[http://www.caboverde.com/nature/plant-01.htm Plantas Endémicas]</ref>

''Verbascum capitis-viridis'' is only found on the islands of [[Santo Antão, Cape Verde|Santo Antão]], [[São Nicolau, Cape Verde|São Nicolau]] and [[Santiago, Cape Verde|Santiago]]. It is considered extinct on the islands of [[São Vicente, Cape Verde|São Vicente]], [[Boa Vista, Cape Verde|Boa Vista]] and [[Maio, Cape Verde|Maio]].<ref name="iucn status 12 November 2021" />
